identity_rule: R03-NK ids are new normalized recovery identities. They are not substitutes for or claims about the unavailable historical NK-C-### identifiers.
authority_rule: These entries constrain future reasoning where compatible with current authority. Current/Lineage/contracts always win if later exact evidence conflicts.

entries.title: Adopt before invent
entries.rule: Do not create a new subsystem, owner or architecture until existing owners/capabilities have been checked and shown inadequate.
entries.reopen_when: An explicit owner gap is demonstrated after Current/Catalog/Lineage and relevant PACKs are checked.

entries.title: Consumer is not owner
entries.rule: A page/product consuming a capability does not inherit ownership of that capability.
entries.failure_prevented: Calendar owning Finance, pages owning Capture, or content pages owning Navigator behavior merely because they call it.
entries.reopen_when: A formal ownership transfer is encoded in current authority/contracts.

entries.title: Release is not authority state
entries.rule: Served, released, canary, tested, Candidate, Current and Human Accepted are distinct states; do not promote between them from publication alone.
entries.failure_prevented: Treating a deployed candidate or green canary as accepted/current product truth.
entries.reopen_when: Never by inference; only explicit authority/pointer change can supersede this rule.

entries.title: Exact Back is not browser back
entries.rule: Do not replace semantic Exact Back with URL history, browser Back, generic popstate, or pixel-only restoration.
entries.failure_prevented: Loss of exact parent/path/item/focus/scroll semantic state.
entries.reopen_when: Only after an exact Human Accepted navigation contract changes the semantic restoration requirement.

entries.title: PASS is environment-scoped
entries.rule: Never generalize a PASS beyond the exact layer/environment exercised. Static, unit, runtime, browser, visual, physical-device, Human and Served evidence remain separate.
entries.failure_prevented: Static-valid HTML or green mocks being reported as live product proof.
entries.reopen_when: Not applicable; broader claims require broader evidence rather than weakening the rule.

entries.title: Corruption is not absence
entries.rule: Distinguish no state from unreadable, inconsistent, partially migrated or otherwise corrupt state; recovery policy and evidence must differ.
entries.failure_prevented: Treating damaged state as empty/default state and silently overwriting recoverable evidence.
entries.reopen_when: A domain-specific contract may refine corruption classes, but must not collapse corruption into absence.

entries.title: Local key or mention does not prove ownership
entries.rule: A localStorage/IndexedDB key, timer mention, page-local class, Jose-specific key or incidental implementation does not establish shared capability ownership.
entries.failure_prevented: Inventing shared owners from archaeology fragments.
entries.reopen_when: A formal current contract/registry explicitly claims the capability.

entries.title: No central mutable coordination journal by default
entries.rule: Do not reintroduce one collaboratively edited central worker-status/event journal merely to simplify coordination.
entries.failure_prevented: Write collisions, global locks, stale heartbeats and a second authority plane.
entries.reopen_when: Only with concrete evidence that the independent-status/derived-network model cannot satisfy a required use case and an ownership/migration plan exists.

entries.title: Later version is not automatic supersession
entries.rule: Do not use higher version numbers or newer timestamps to erase older accepted capability scope, rollback donors, or gains lost later.
entries.failure_prevented: Replacing Human Accepted V23 physics with a later Navigator build or treating PageKit V37 as full UX acceptance.
entries.reopen_when: An exact scoped supersession edge and authority change are recorded.

entries.title: Do not replace exact artifacts with reconstructions
entries.rule: Recovered phenotype or reconstructed bytes remain evidence/reference, not authentic replacements for exact verified artifacts.
entries.failure_prevented: Reconstruction being mislabeled as canon or Human Accepted historical bytes.
entries.reopen_when: Authentic exact bytes are recovered and verified.

entries.title: Designed falsification is not empirical falsification
entries.rule: Do not mark a high-leverage assumption falsified merely because an attack/test was designed; execution evidence is required.
entries.failure_prevented: Invented empirical outcomes and false scientific closure.
entries.historical_evidence: AMP-2 reported 60 designed falsification attempts against 20 assumptions and HIGH_LEVERAGE_ASSUMPTIONS_FALSIFIED=0 specifically because unexecuted outcomes were not invented.
entries.reopen_when: A specific attempt is executed and its evidence is preserved.

entries.title: Search breadth is not authority
entries.rule: Counts of work units, alternatives, experiments, tests, contradictions or negative entries measure search/work breadth, not correctness or authority.
entries.failure_prevented: Using impressive aggregate counts to bypass exact proof or Human Acceptance.
entries.historical_evidence: AMP-2 reported 1235 WU, 213 alternatives, 50 experiments, 150 tests and 40 negative entries while still preserving evidence boundaries.
entries.reopen_when: Never as a general rule; individual evidence objects may justify individual conclusions.

entries.title: Decision overturn requires exact scoped evidence
entries.rule: Do not reconstruct or repeat a historical decision overturn from the aggregate count alone; preserve before/after decision, evidence and scope.
entries.failure_prevented: Phantom reversals and loss of why a prior choice changed.
entries.historical_evidence: AMP-2 reported PREVIOUS_DECISIONS_OVERTURNED=16, but the exact 16 records were not durably recovered.
entries.reopen_when: The exact original decision-overturn record is recovered or a new current evidence-based decision is made.

entries.title: Contradictions stay explicit until resolved
entries.rule: Do not collapse a contradiction into a conclusion without evidence, and do not invent contradiction contents from an aggregate count.
entries.failure_prevented: False convergence and fabricated historical detail.
entries.historical_evidence: AMP-2 reported NEW_CONTRADICTIONS=30; exact bodies were not recovered.
entries.reopen_when: A specific contradiction record and resolution evidence are recovered or newly created.

entries.title: Historical provisional winner is not current owner
entries.rule: The historical C1 semantic-contract/local-backend choice may preserve a design principle, but its label must not be promoted into a current subsystem/owner without current registration.
entries.failure_prevented: Resurrecting old architecture names as parallel authorities.
entries.reopen_when: A current workstream/contract deliberately reuses the label with explicit lineage.

entries.title: Stable link must not erase build identity
entries.rule: Do not implement same-link convenience by mutating untraceable latest bytes. Stable entry and immutable/test-bound identities must coexist with promotion/rollback evidence.
entries.failure_prevented: A stable URL becoming evidence-free mutable state with no trustworthy rollback.
entries.reopen_when: A release mechanism proves equivalent identity, acceptance and rollback guarantees by another method.

entries.title: Consumer proof before shared-owner promotion
entries.rule: Before promoting a shared owner/capability, prove the real consumers and their contracts instead of generalizing from one page or test fixture.
entries.failure_prevented: Globalizing a local abstraction and breaking unrelated consumers.
entries.reopen_when: Representative consumer evidence and explicit owner registration exist.

entries.title: Do not fabricate missing historical identities
entries.rule: Do not synthesize NK-C-###, CR-C-###, Pareto rankings, experiment definitions or original hashes and present them as recovered originals.
entries.reopen_when: Authentic original artifacts become available and can be verified.

historical_counts_not_expanded_into_fake.rule: The normalized register intentionally has a different count and identity space. It preserves only recoverable/reconciled rules, not fictional reconstructions of all 40 historical entries.
